title: Developing Full Search Functionality (Global Command Palette Modal & Dedicated Search Page)
description: Per user directive ('develop search functionality'), built comprehensive search engine and UI across the entire studio: a global command palette modal (Cmd+K / Ctrl+K and header-search-btn) and a dedicated editorial search page (/search?q=...) rendered in Frame Cottage's PNG-styled spatial canvas architecture. Features fuzzy multi-term keyword search across all 6 core service verticals, 15 framing models & products, 11 museum-grade materials/machinery, and 6 studio actions & shortcuts. Includes category filter pills (All, Verticals, Products, Materials, Portals), trending studio search pills, live grouped results list with keyboard navigation (Up, Down, Enter, Esc), empty states with WhatsApp and RFQ CTAs, real-time URL synchronization, mobile search submission in MobileNav drawer, dual-theme support (Museum Dark Mode #1A1A1A and Warm Light Mode #FAF8F5), 390x844 zero horizontal overflow, 0 TypeScript/build errors across 19 static routes, and 100% test pass rate in Playwright (8/8 in task-29 suite).
acceptanceCriteria: Search Index & Engine (lib/search/search-index.ts) indexing all 6 service verticals, framing products, archival materials, machinery, and studio actions with fuzzy multi-token matching and category grouping
Global Search Modal / Command Palette (components/search/search-modal.tsx) accessible via data-testid='header-search-btn' and global Cmd+K / Ctrl+K keyboard shortcut with frosted backdrop blur

Modal UI with input (data-testid='search-modal-input'), autofocus, clear button, category filter pills ('All', 'Verticals', 'Products', 'Materials', 'Portals'), trending search pills ('Walnut', 'TruVue', 'Signage', 'CNC Screen', 'GeM Tender', 'Gold Leaf'), live grouped results list (data-testid='search-results-list'), keyboard navigation (Up/Down arrows, Enter to open, Esc to close), and dedicated page button (data-testid='view-all-results-btn')
Dedicated Search Results Page (app/search/page.tsx & components/search/search-page-content.tsx) supporting /search?q=... wrapped in React Suspense

Dedicated page features editorial title, result counter badge (data-testid='search-results-counter'), interactive search input (data-testid='search-page-input'), category filter pills (data-testid='search-filter-...'), PNG-styled spatial canvas 4:3 dashed drop zones, technical specs lists, and direct action buttons

Empty search state (data-testid='search-empty-state') when query has no matches, displaying 'No studio records found matching [query]', trending suggestion pills, and direct WhatsApp / RFQ consultation CTAs
Integration with existing navigation: SiteHeader wires header-search-btn and Cmd+K to open SearchModal; MobileNav wires quick search input/form to navigate to /search?q=... and close drawer
Full dual-theme compatibility across Museum Dark Mode (#1A1A1A) and Warm Museum Light Mode (#FAF8F5)
Mobile viewport responsiveness at 390x844 with zero horizontal overflow across all search interfaces
Comprehensive automated Playwright test suite tests/task-29-search.spec.ts passing with 100% success rate (8/8 passed)

High-resolution visual proof screenshots captured: task-29-search-modal-dark.png, task-29-search-modal-light.png, task-29-search-results-page-dark.png, task-29-search-results-page-light.png, and task-29-search-mobile.png saved in .agent/screenshots/ and copied to parent brain directory
npm run build compiles with 0 TypeScript and 0 build errors across all 19 static routes

steps.description: Architect Studio Search Index and Engine
steps.details: Created lib/search/search-index.ts with comprehensive index spanning 6 service verticals, 15 framing models & products, 11 materials, glazing & machinery, and 6 studio actions & shortcuts. Implemented multi-token fuzzy matching, category normalization, and grouped results retrieval.

steps.description: Build Global Search Modal / Command Palette
steps.details: Constructed components/search/search-modal.tsx with frosted backdrop overlay, dashed border atelier dialog, category filter pills, trending search pills, live grouped results list, keyboard navigation (Up, Down, Enter, Esc), and 'View all results on dedicated page' CTA.

steps.description: Integrate Search Modal into SiteHeader and MobileNav
steps.details: Wired header-search-btn and global Cmd+K / Ctrl+K keyboard shortcut in components/navigation/site-header.tsx to open SearchModal. Updated components/navigation/mobile-nav.tsx to submit search queries and navigate to /search?q=... while closing the mobile drawer.

steps.description: Build Dedicated Search Page with PNG-Styled Spatial Canvas Architecture
steps.details: Constructed app/search/page.tsx (wrapped in React Suspense) and components/search/search-page-content.tsx featuring editorial serif header, result counter badge, interactive search bar with URL synchronization, category filter pills, 4:3 dashed drop zone cards with technical specs, and empty state with WhatsApp consultation CTA.

steps.description: Author automated Playwright test suite tests/task-29-search.spec.ts
steps.details: Authored 8 comprehensive test specs covering header button click, Cmd+K / Ctrl+K shortcut, search modal filtering and keyboard navigation, item navigation, dedicated page rendering, category filter switching, empty state, and 390x844 mobile viewport zero overflow.

Captured task-29-search-modal-dark.png, task-29-search-modal-light.png, task-29-search-results-page-dark.png, task-29-search-results-page-light.png, and task-29-search-mobile.png saved in .agent/screenshots/ and copied to parent brain directory.

steps.description: Verify quality gates: build and complete Playwright test suite
steps.details: Compiled production build with 0 errors across 19/19 static routes; ran complete Playwright test suite with 100% pass rate.
